boundaries.iterative_limit: Pinned GRC/RW expose no maximum iteration count. Native nullopt preserves that default; an optional caller limit produces a typed deterministic failure for hostile parameters.
boundaries.non_ml_oracle: The oracle AST-loads only node_rank.py classes. GRC/RW matrix inputs and RW COO behavior use narrow NumPy fakes because the pinned non-ML image intentionally has no SciPy.
boundaries.random_stream: Pinned RandomNodeRank uses NumPy's mutable global legacy stream. Native code requires the completed caller-owned NumpyRandomState and preserves both shuffle values and continuation exactly.
boundaries.resource_selection: Native default selection uses exact typed AttributeKind::resource IDs. Python's string/list membership quirks for custom attribute protocol objects remain a cold dynamic boundary.
boundaries.result_storage: Pinned rank_nodes dynamically adds node_ranking/ranked_nodes/node_ranking_values to BaseNetwork. Native returns a typed ordered vector and does not mutate the frozen BaseNetwork schema.

payload_encoding: canonical JSON; scalar rows are [node,s,score_raw64,+0_raw64], NPS rows are [node,p,nrm_raw64,distance_raw64]
